detail.title: fix(recipe): use MBS 1 in the Qwen3.5-9B GB200 deterministic recipe to address OOM

files.patch:
@@ -272,9 +272,11 @@ def qwen35_text_9b_pretrain_8gpu_gb200_bf16_deterministic_config() -> ConfigCont
     cfg = qwen35_text_9b_pretrain_8gpu_gb200_bf16_config()
     apply_determinism_overrides(cfg)
 
-    # Standalone Qwen3.5 override, not part of apply_determinism_overrides: Megatron-Core rejects
-    # deterministic_mode with Gated DeltaNet unless the torch kernel backend is used.
+    # TODO: revert the two overrides below once a deterministic fused GDN kernel is available.
+    # Megatron-Core rejects deterministic_mode with Gated DeltaNet unless the torch backend is used.
     cfg.model.gdn_kernel_backend = "torch"
+    # MBS 2 OOMs with the torch GDN backend.
+    cfg.train.micro_batch_size = 1
 
     # Keep the exact process environment visible on the recipe.
     cfg.env_vars = {

@@ -68,4 +68,7 @@ def test_text_9b_pretrain_deterministic_applies_determinism():
     assert cfg.model.gdn_kernel_backend == "torch"
     assert cfg.model.tensor_model_parallel_size == base.model.tensor_model_parallel_size == 1
     assert cfg.train.global_batch_size == base.train.global_batch_size
+    # TODO: revert with the recipe override once a deterministic fused GDN kernel is available.
+    assert cfg.train.micro_batch_size == 1
+    assert base.train.micro_batch_size == 2
     assert cfg.env_vars == DETERMINISM_ENV_VARS
